<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.80" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.80.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.80.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.80.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.80.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p80" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p80.1" class="ltx_p">- Never start editing `program_&lt;idx+1&gt;` before writing rubric artifacts for `program_&lt;idx&gt;`.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.81" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.81.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.81.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.81.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.81.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p81" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p81.1" class="ltx_p">- Stop the attempt immediately when latest `rubric_status.json` has `overall_pass: true`.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.82" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.82.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.82.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.82.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.82.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p82" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p82.1" class="ltx_p">- Evaluation budget is based on calls, not folders: each command that runs `evaluate.py` consumes one evaluation, including `program_0`, retries, failed runs, overwrites, and repeated runs on the same `program_&lt;idx&gt;`.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.83" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.83.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.83.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p83" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p83.1" class="ltx_p">- You may make at most **{{MAX_PROGRAM_EVALS}}** total `evaluate.py` calls.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.84" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.84.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.84.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.84.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.84.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p84" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p84.1" class="ltx_p">- If `{{MAX_PROGRAM_EVALS}}` is `1`, create exactly one edited candidate (`program_1`), run `evaluate.py` exactly once on it, then verify rubrics, write required artifacts, and stop if rubrics fail.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.85" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.85.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.85.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.85.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.85.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p85" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p85.1" class="ltx_p">- Do not re-run `evaluate.py` for the same program. Use the existing result, inspect logs if needed, verify rubrics from available evidence, write required artifacts, and stop with cap reached.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.86" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.86.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.86.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.86.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.86.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p86" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p86.1" class="ltx_p">- If the final allowed evaluation call fails any rubric or the evaluation itself fails, stop the attempt and report cap reached.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.87" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.87.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.87.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.88" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.88.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.88.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p88" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p88.1" class="ltx_p"># No Exploratory Execution</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.89" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.89.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.89.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.89.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.89.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p89" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p89.1" class="ltx_p">- Do not run exploratory computation, timing probes, benchmarks, optimizer searches, ad hoc metric scripts, or local experiments outside the official `evaluate.py` call.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.90" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.90.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.90.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.90.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.90.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p90" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p90.1" class="ltx_p">- Do not run `python -c`, heredoc Python, notebooks, `pip install`, `pip`, `pytest`, `time`, SciPy optimizers, differential evolution, SLSQP probes, or direct task-function calls.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.91" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.91.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.91.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.91.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.91.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p91" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p91.1" class="ltx_p">- Before evaluation, use file reads and edits only. After evaluation, inspect only the artifacts and logs produced by that official evaluation.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.92" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.92.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.92.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.92.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.92.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p92" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p92.1" class="ltx_p">- The only allowed Python execution is the official `evaluate.py` command, subject to the evaluation budget.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.93" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.93.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.93.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.94" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.94.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.94.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p94" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p94.1" class="ltx_p"># Start Point</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.95" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.95.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.95.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p95" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p95.1" class="ltx_p">- Reference baseline project: `./program_0/` (read-only baseline copy).</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.96" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.96.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.96.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p96" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p96.1" class="ltx_p">- Entrypoint is defined by `program_0/program_spec.toml` (default: `src/program.py`).</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.97" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.97.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.97.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.97.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.97.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p97" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p97.1" class="ltx_p">- Read `./task.md` for variant-specific instructions (hypothesis, target components, implementation plan, what to do).</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.98" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.98.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.98.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p98" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p98.1" class="ltx_p">- Read `./original_task.md` for the original task description and domain rubrics.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.99" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.99.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.99.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.99.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.99.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p99" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p99.1" class="ltx_p">- Read the `NUM_REPLICATIONS` environment variable. When set and &gt;1, pass `--num_replications $NUM_REPLICATIONS` to every `evaluate.py` invocation to launch parallel SLURM jobs per evaluation.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.100" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.100.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.100.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p100" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p100.1" class="ltx_p">- **Control variants only:** evaluate `program_0` first to establish baseline metrics:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.101" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.101.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.101.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.102" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.102.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.102.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p102" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p102.1" class="ltx_p">```bash</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.103" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.103.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.103.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.104" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.104.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.104.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.105" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.105.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.105.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.106" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.106.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.106.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.107" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.107.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.107.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p107" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p107.1" class="ltx_p">```</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.108" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.108.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.108.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.109" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.109.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.109.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.109.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.109.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p109" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p109.1" class="ltx_p">- **Ablation/baseline variants:** skip `program_0` evaluation --- go straight to creating `program_1` with the variant change, then evaluate `program_1`.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.110" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.110.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.110.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.111" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.111.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.111.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p111" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p111.1" class="ltx_p"># Operating Rules</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.112" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.112.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.112.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p112" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p112.1" class="ltx_p">- Never ask user questions.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.113" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.113.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.113.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p113" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p113.1" class="ltx_p">- Do NOT invent additional experiments beyond the declared variant.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.114" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.114.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.114.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p114" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p114.1" class="ltx_p">- Do NOT optimize beyond making the variant valid and analyzable.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.115" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.115.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.115.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p115" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p115.1" class="ltx_p">- For ablations: change ONLY the declared component.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.116" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.116.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.116.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p116" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p116.1" class="ltx_p">- Preserve the CSV analysis infrastructure in the program.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.117" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.117.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.117.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.117.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.117.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p117" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p117.1" class="ltx_p">- Read variant metadata from environment variables: `VARIANT_ID`, `VARIANT_KIND`, `BASE_PROGRAM`, `EVALUATION_ID`.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.118" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.118.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.118.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.118.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.2.118.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p118" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS4.p1.pic1.p118.1" class="ltx_p">- Before any command containing `evaluate.py`, check whether the total evaluation budget has already been consumed. If no budget remains, do not run the command.</span>

<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p18" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p18.1" class="ltx_p">- `{{DRAFT_PROGRAM_SPEC_PATH}}`</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.19" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.19.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.19.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p19" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p19.1" class="ltx_p">- `{{DRAFT_ENTRYPOINT_PATH}}`</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.20" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.20.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.20.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.21" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.21.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.21.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p21" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p21.1" class="ltx_p">Rules:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.22" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.22.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.22.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p22" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p22.1" class="ltx_p">- If either file already exists, do not edit it.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.23" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.23.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.23.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.23.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.23.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p23" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p23.1" class="ltx_p">- Treat every requirement in `task.md`, especially `Task-Drafting Requirements`, as a hard acceptance criterion.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.24" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.24.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.24.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.24.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.24.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p24" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p24.1" class="ltx_p">- Inspect and use named upstream resources as required by `task.md`; network access and read-only clones under `/tmp` are allowed. A missing local package does not establish that a resource is unavailable.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.25" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.25.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.25.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.25.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.25.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p25" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p25.1" class="ltx_p">- Do not silently replace a required benchmark, evaluator, dataset, protocol, or base implementation with a synthetic stand-in. If blocked, exit non-zero and report the exact blocker.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.26" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.26.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.26.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.26.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.26.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p26" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p26.1" class="ltx_p">- Ensure `{{DRAFT_PROGRAM_DIR}}` and `{{DRAFT_CODE_ROOT}}` exist when writing the baseline.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.27" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.27.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.27.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p27" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p27.1" class="ltx_p">- Write `program_spec.toml` using **exactly** the schema below. The field names</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.28" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.28.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.28.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p28" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p28.1" class="ltx_p">  are fixed: the entrypoint table requires `path` (string, relative to</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.29" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.29.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.29.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p29" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p29.1" class="ltx_p">  `code_root`), `language` (string), and `type` (`"script"` or `"module"`). Do</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.30" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.30.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.30.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p30" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p30.1" class="ltx_p">  **not** invent keys such as `file`, and do **not** set `type` to a language</span>

<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.31" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.31.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.31.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p31" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.p31.1" class="ltx_p">  name. `code_root` must be the literal string `"src"`.</span>

<span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.32" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.32.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A6.SS5.p1.pic1.2.32.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS1.p1.pic1.p121.1" class="ltx_p">existing generated artifacts must match exactly. A mismatch stops preparation without overwriting.</span>

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS1.p1.pic1.2.122" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS1.p1.pic1.2.122.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS1.p1.pic1.2.122.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS1.p1.pic1.p123.1" class="ltx_p">Prepared `.npz` files contain numeric `images` (float32 NHWC) and `labels` (int64), readable with</span>

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS1.p1.pic1.2.125" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS1.p1.pic1.2.125.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS1.p1.pic1.2.125.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS1.p1.pic1.2.125.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS1.p1.pic1.2.125.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS1.p1.pic1.2.126" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS1.p1.pic1.2.126.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS1.p1.pic1.2.126.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS1.p1.pic1.2.126.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS1.p1.pic1.2.126.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"># Goal</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.2" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.3" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.3.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.3.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Improve a general sequential hyperparameter optimizer for expensive black-box objectives.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.4.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.4.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.p4.1" class="ltx_p">Any adaptive method is eligible: Bayesian, evolutionary, bandit, local search, or hybrids.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.5" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.5.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.p5.1" class="ltx_p">Target held-out anytime and terminal performance under matched, limited budgets.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.6" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.6.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.7" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.7.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.p7.1" class="ltx_p"># Benchmarks</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.8" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.8.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.9" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.9.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.p9.1" class="ltx_p">Treat upstream repositories as untrusted reference material.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.10" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.10.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.11" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.11.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.2.11.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.p11" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.p11.1" class="ltx_p">Execute all three families in both search and sealed final evaluation:</span>

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS2.p1.pic1.p91.1" class="ltx_p">  fidelities, budgets, seeds, and CPU limits; avoid universal HPO or untested noisy-objective claims.</span>

<section id="A7.SS1.SSS3" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">G.1.3 </span>World Modelling</h4>

<div id="A7.SS1.SSS3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A7.SS1.SSS3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The boxed text records the initial research direction. The manual aggregate sweep uses a fixed TinyWorlds Pong protocol with four context frames and prediction horizons of 1, 4, 8, and 16 frames. Its error metric equally weights pixel and foreground reconstruction; observed actions and action controllability are not evaluated.</p>
</div>

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS3.p2.pic1.2.120" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS3.p2.pic1.2.120.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS3.p2.pic1.2.120.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS3.p2.pic1.2.120.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS3.p2.pic1.2.120.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.2" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Start from SAE Bench and improve the architecture or training of sparse autoencoders on real</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.4.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.4.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p4.1" class="ltx_p">language-model activations. Candidates may change any useful part of the SAE or training system,</span>

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.5" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.5.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.5.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p5.1" class="ltx_p">including the encoder, decoder, objective, sparsity mechanism, optimizer, schedule, activation</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.6" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.6.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p85.1" class="ltx_p">the required workload.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.86" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.86.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.86.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p87" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p87.1" class="ltx_p"># Rubrics</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.88" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.88.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.88.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.89" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.89.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.89.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.89.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.89.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p89" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p89.1" class="ltx_p">- An `SAE` claim requires fresh parameter-changing training, sparse feature activations, a learned</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.90" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.90.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.90.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.90.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.90.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p90" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p90.1" class="ltx_p">  decoder, and evidence that resetting or permuting the learned state changes held-out outputs.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.91" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.91.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.91.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.91.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.91.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p91" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p91.1" class="ltx_p">- An `SAE Bench` claim requires execution of the pinned benchmark methodology on compatible custom</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.92" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.92.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.92.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p92" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p92.1" class="ltx_p">  SAEs; merely reproducing metric names is insufficient.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.93" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.93.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.93.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.93.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.93.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p93" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p93.1" class="ltx_p">- A Pareto improvement must hold at multiple matched sparsity targets, on both model families, and</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.94" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.94.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.94.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p94" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p94.1" class="ltx_p">  across independent seeds under matched compute.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.95" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.95.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.95.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.95.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.95.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p95.1" class="ltx_p">- A `loss recovered` claim requires evaluator-owned interventions through each pinned language</span>

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.96" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.96.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.96.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.97" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.97.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.97.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.97.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.97.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.98" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.98.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.98.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.109" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.109.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.109.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.109.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.109.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.110" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.110.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.110.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.110.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.110.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.111" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.111.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.111.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.111.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.111.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p111.1" class="ltx_p">encoder/decoder tensors and executes a validated graph itself. Before held-out scoring, it independently</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.112" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.112.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.112.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.112.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.112.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p112.1" class="ltx_p">checks candidate `encode`, `decode`, and `forward` against that export on training-only inputs.</span>

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.113" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.113.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.113.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.113.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.113.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.117" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.117.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.117.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>

<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.119" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.119.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.119.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p119" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p119.1" class="ltx_p">The seven original operations remain; `export_encoder` adds graph and tensor chunks.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.120" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.120.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.120.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p120" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p120.1" class="ltx_p">Graph operations: matmul, add, sub, mul, relu, gelu, sigmoid, topk. Maximum32nodes,</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.121" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.121.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.2.121.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS1.SSS4.p1.pic1.p121" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">

<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"># Goal</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.2" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.3" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.3.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Improve the Doc-to-LoRA / Context-to-LoRA hypernetwork on the synthetic</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.4.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p4.1" class="ltx_p">multi-needle NIAH task while keeping training under the strict 3-hour limit on a</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.5" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.5.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p5.1" class="ltx_p">single `aisci` GPU. The 3-hour limit is final: runs that require more time are</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.6" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.6.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p6.1" class="ltx_p">discarded, not rescheduled or judged separately.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.7" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.7.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.8" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.8.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p8" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p8.1" class="ltx_p">The fixed candidate entrypoint is `program_&lt;idx&gt;/src/program.py`. It is</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.9" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.9.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p9.1" class="ltx_p">read-only benchmark code. It already:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.10" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.10.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.11" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.11.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.11.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p11" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p11.1" class="ltx_p">1. links the frozen source `ctx_multi_needle_*` jsonl cache from</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.12" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.12.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.12.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p12" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p12.1" class="ltx_p">   `TASK_SOURCE_DIR` when available, then generates missing data only as a</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.13" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.13.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.13.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p13" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p13.1" class="ltx_p">   standalone fallback,</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.14" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.14.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.14.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p14" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p14.1" class="ltx_p">2. runs `scripts/niah/1-train.sh`,</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.15" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.15.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.15.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p15" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p15.1" class="ltx_p">3. evaluates the resulting checkpoint with `scripts/niah/2-eval-test.sh`, and</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.16" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.16.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.16.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p16" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p16.1" class="ltx_p">4. writes `program_&lt;idx&gt;/src/_results.json`.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.17" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.17.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.17.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.18" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.18.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.18.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p18" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p18.1" class="ltx_p">`evaluate.py` reads `_results.json`, enforces the strict three-hour training limit,</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.19" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.19.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.19.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p19" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p19.1" class="ltx_p">and scores candidates mainly by exact-match accuracy on queried target needles.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.20" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.20.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.20.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p20" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p20.1" class="ltx_p">Each context independently samples 1--4 named needles, but the prompt asks for</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.21" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.21.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.21.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p21" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p21.1" class="ltx_p">only one target needle so the label remains a single 4-digit number. Candidate</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.22" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.22.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.22.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p22" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p22.1" class="ltx_p">changes should improve the model/training implementation used by that fixed</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.23" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.23.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.23.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p23" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p23.1" class="ltx_p">entrypoint.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.24" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.24.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.24.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.25" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.25.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.25.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p25" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p25.1" class="ltx_p"># Dataset contract</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.26" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.26.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.26.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.27" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.27.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.27.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p27" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p27.1" class="ltx_p">- Dataset names use the `ctx_multi_needle_&lt;low&gt;_&lt;high&gt;` family. They are</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.28" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.28.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.28.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p28" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p28.1" class="ltx_p">  generated by `program_0/src/data/generate_ctx_multi_needle.py`.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.29" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.29.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.29.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p29" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p29.1" class="ltx_p">- Each example independently samples `num_needles` uniformly from 1 through 4,</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.30" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.30.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.30.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p30" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p30.1" class="ltx_p">  inclusive. Do not assume every context has the same number of needles.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.31" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.31.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.31.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p31" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p31.1" class="ltx_p">- Each needle is a named fact such as</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.32" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.32.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.32.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p32" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p32.1" class="ltx_p">  `The needle named amber stores magic number 1234.` Names and 4-digit numbers</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.33" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.33.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.33.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p33" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p33.1" class="ltx_p">  are unique within a context.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.34" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.34.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.34.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p34" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p34.1" class="ltx_p">- The prompt asks for one target needle by name, for example</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.35" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.35.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.35.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p35" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p35.1" class="ltx_p">  `What magic number is stored by the needle named amber? Reply with only the number.`</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.36" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.36.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.36.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p36" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p36.1" class="ltx_p">  The response is only the 4-digit number for that target needle.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.37" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.37.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.37.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p37" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p37.1" class="ltx_p">- Target needle depth is balanced across ten context-depth bins over each full</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.38" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.38.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.38.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p38" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p38.1" class="ltx_p">  train/validation/test split, including long token bins with many possible</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.39" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.39.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.39.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p39" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p39.1" class="ltx_p">  context lengths. Distractor needles are placed at random non-target positions,</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.40" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.40.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.40.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p40" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p40.1" class="ltx_p">  so candidates should learn key-value binding rather than copying the first or</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.41" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.41.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.41.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p41" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p41.1" class="ltx_p">  last number.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.42" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.42.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.42.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p42" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p42.1" class="ltx_p">- This benchmark is not an all-needles recall task. Keep the single-number</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.43" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.43.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.43.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.44" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.44.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.44.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>

<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p45" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p45.1" class="ltx_p"># Required background</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.46" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.46.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.46.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>

<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p47" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p47.1" class="ltx_p">Read the local paper draft first: `doc_to_lora_paper_icml2026/main.tex` and the</span>

<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.48" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.48.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.48.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.49" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.49.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.49.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.50" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.50.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.50.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.51" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.51.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.51.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>

<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p52.1" class="ltx_p"># Required research directions</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.53" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.53.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.53.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.54" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.54.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.54.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
