<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.55" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.55.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.55.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.56" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.56.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.56.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p56" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p56.1" class="ltx_p">1. **How to merge per-chunk LoRAs.** The current implementation in</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.57" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.57.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.57.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p57" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p57.1" class="ltx_p">   `src/ctx_to_lora/modeling/lora_merger.py` directly concatenates the generated</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.58" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.58.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.58.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p58" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p58.1" class="ltx_p">   A and B matrices from different context chunks. Consider alternatives such as</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.59" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.59.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.59.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p59" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p59.1" class="ltx_p">   normalization, learned or heuristic chunk weighting, low-rank recompression,</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.60" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.60.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.60.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p60" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p60.1" class="ltx_p">   rank budgeting, gating, or merge rules that reduce destructive interference.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.61" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.61.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.61.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.62" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.62.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.62.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p62" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p62.1" class="ltx_p">2. **Inductive bias in the hypernetwork output space.** Consider where LoRAs are</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.63" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.63.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.63.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p63" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p63.1" class="ltx_p">   applied and what the hypernetwork emits. Examples: which target modules are</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.64" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.64.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.64.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p64" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p64.1" class="ltx_p">   useful (`down_proj`, attention projections, MLP projections), whether all</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.65" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.65.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.65.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p65" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p65.1" class="ltx_p">   layers are necessary, whether rank should vary by layer/module, whether a</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.66" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.66.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.66.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p66" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p66.1" class="ltx_p">   shared basis plus generated coefficients is enough, or whether cheaper output</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.67" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.67.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.67.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p67" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p67.1" class="ltx_p">   spaces such as diagonal/residual scales, layernorm shifts, KV-focused adapters,</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.68" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.68.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.68.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p68" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p68.1" class="ltx_p">   or generated biases give better accuracy per compute.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.69" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.69.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.69.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.70" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.70.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.70.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p70" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p70.1" class="ltx_p">3. **Inductive bias in the hypernetwork architecture.** The current cross-attention</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.71" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.71.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.71.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p71" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p71.1" class="ltx_p">   design assumes each latent query corresponds to one generated LoRA rank.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.72" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.72.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.72.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p72" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p72.1" class="ltx_p">   Consider whether that rank-query binding is necessary. Examples: shared latent</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.73" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.73.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.73.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p73" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p73.1" class="ltx_p">   factors with learned rank mixing, hierarchical queries for layer/module groups,</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.74" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.74.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.74.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p74" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p74.1" class="ltx_p">   separate queries for A and B factors, rank tokens conditioned on context</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.75" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.75.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.75.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p75" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p75.1" class="ltx_p">   length, or architectures that generate a compact basis plus coefficients</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.76" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.76.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.76.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p76" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p76.1" class="ltx_p">   before expanding to LoRA parameters.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.77" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.77.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.77.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.78" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.78.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.78.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p78" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p78.1" class="ltx_p"># Runtime rules</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.79" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.79.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.79.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.80" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.80.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.80.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p80" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p80.1" class="ltx_p">- Training must complete in less than 3 hours on one `aisci` GPU. This limit is</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.81" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.81.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.81.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p81" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p81.1" class="ltx_p">  strict and final. Any run with `train_runtime_seconds &gt; 10800` is invalid and</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.82" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.82.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.82.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p82" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p82.1" class="ltx_p">  will be discarded, regardless of accuracy or partial progress.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.83" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.83.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.83.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p83" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p83.1" class="ltx_p">- The fixed entrypoint must continue to run the two task scripts named above.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.84" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.84.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.84.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p84" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p84.1" class="ltx_p">  Do not replace them with fake metrics, cached answers, or a no-op.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.85" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.85.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.85.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p85" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p85.1" class="ltx_p">- The fixed entrypoint records a `full_epoch_probe` in `_results.json` after</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.86" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.86.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.86.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p86" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p86.1" class="ltx_p">  training. Leave this probe intact; it reports whether full 1-epoch training is</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.87" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.87.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.87.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p87" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p87.1" class="ltx_p">  feasible for the candidate under the strict three-hour limit.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.88" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.88.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.88.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p88" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p88.1" class="ltx_p">- Default evaluation is intentionally small for iteration, but its environment</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.89" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.89.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.2.89.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS2.p1.pic1.p89" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">

<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.4.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.4.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.5" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.5.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.5.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.6" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.6.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">

<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.7" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.7.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.8" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.8.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p8" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p8.1" class="ltx_p">This follows the meta-black-box loops used for</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.9" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.9.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p9.1" class="ltx_p">[Learned Evolution Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.11260) and</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.10" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.10.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.10.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.10.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p10.1" class="ltx_p">[Learned Genetic Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.03995), while testing whether a cheap</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.11" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.11.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.11.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.11.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.11.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p11" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p11.1" class="ltx_p">analytic training distribution can discover a LearnedCMA that transfers to control. Promising</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.12" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.12.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.12.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.12.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.12.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p12" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p12.1" class="ltx_p">architectures include permutation-equivariant or self-attention modules that jointly update the</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.13" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.13.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.13.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.13.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.13.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p13" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p13.1" class="ltx_p">mean and a diagonal, low-rank, factorized, or full covariance representation. Choose the design</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.14" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.14.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.14.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p14" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p14.1" class="ltx_p">from experimental evidence.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.15" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.15.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.15.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.16" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.16.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.16.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p16" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p16.1" class="ltx_p"># Rubrics</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.17" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.17.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.17.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.18" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.18.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.18.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p18" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p18.1" class="ltx_p">- Maximize the primary CMA-anchored Ant-2000 AUC score; initial policy = 0, CMA-ES = 1.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.19" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.19.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.19.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.19.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.19.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p19" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p19.1" class="ltx_p">- Implement a valid evosax-style learned distribution strategy with 1–1,024 meta-parameters.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.20" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.20.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.20.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.20.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.20.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p20.1" class="ltx_p">- Meta-train only on the fixed BBOB distribution, then transfer frozen learned weights to Ant.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.21" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.21.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.21.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.21.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.21.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p21" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p21.1" class="ltx_p">- Preserve dimension/population generality and horizon-free, evidence-conditioned updates.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.22" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.22.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.22.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p22" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p22.1" class="ltx_p">- Keep the fixed evaluator, seeds, budgets, scoring, and runtime contracts unchanged.</span>

<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.23" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.23.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.23.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>

<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p24" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p24.1" class="ltx_p"># Scientific contract</span>

<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.25" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.25.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.25.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.26" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.26.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.26.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p26" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">

</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.27" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.27.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.27.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.28" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.28.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.28.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p28.1" class="ltx_p">`program.py` must export:</span>

<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.29" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.29.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.29.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.30" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.30.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.30.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p30" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p30.1" class="ltx_p">```python</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.31" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.31.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.31.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.32" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.32.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.32.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p32" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p32.1" class="ltx_p">```</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.33" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.33.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.33.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.34" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.34.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.34.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.34.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.34.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p34" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p34.1" class="ltx_p">`program_0` is a self-contained port of the evosax LearnedES architecture and lifecycle. Its</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.35" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.35.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.35.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.35.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.35.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p35" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p35.1" class="ltx_p">142 learned weights are freshly initialized and become the initial mean of outer CMA-ES; no</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.36" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.36.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.36.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.36.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.36.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p36" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p36.1" class="ltx_p">pretrained checkpoint is loaded. You may rewrite its state, features, architecture, sampling,</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.37" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.37.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.37.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p37" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p37.1" class="ltx_p">mean/covariance updates, and the outer-CMA scalar settings exposed by</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.38" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.38.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.38.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p38" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p38.1" class="ltx_p">`CandidateDefinition.outer_settings`.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.39" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.39.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.39.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.40" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.40.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.40.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p40" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p40.1" class="ltx_p">The learned parameter PyTree must:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.41" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.41.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.41.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.42" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.42.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.42.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p42" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p42.1" class="ltx_p">- match `strategy.default_params.params` in structure, shape, and dtype;</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.43" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.43.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.43.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p43" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p43.1" class="ltx_p">- contain 1–1,024 finite floating-point scalars;</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.44" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.44.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.44.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p44" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p44.1" class="ltx_p">- work with evosax-style `init`, `ask`, `tell`, and `get_mean` signatures;</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.45" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.45.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.45.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.45.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.45.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p45" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p45.1" class="ltx_p">- have the same structure, shapes, dtype, initialization, name, strategy type, and outer settings</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.46" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.46.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.46.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p46" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p46.1" class="ltx_p">  when built for 10-D/population-16 BBOB and 704-D/population-256 Ant;</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.47" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.47.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.47.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.47.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.47.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p47" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p47.1" class="ltx_p">- express domain- and population-size generalization through generic normalized formulas, never</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.48" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.48.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.48.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.48.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.48.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p48" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p48.1" class="ltx_p">  by branching on the known BBOB/Ant dimensions, population sizes, task identity, or environment.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.49" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.49.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.49.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.50" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.50.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.50.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.50.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.50.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p50" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p50.1" class="ltx_p">Every learned distribution decision---including mean, scale, covariance, step-size, learning-rate,</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.51" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.51.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.51.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.51.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.51.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p51" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p51.1" class="ltx_p">and gating updates---must define an **anytime optimizer**. It must not condition optimizer decisions</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.52" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.52.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.52.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.52.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.52.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p52" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p52.1" class="ltx_p">on absolute generation, elapsed iteration, the fixed evaluation budget or horizon, a countdown,</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.53" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.53.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.53.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.53.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.53.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p53" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p53.1" class="ltx_p">or a timestamp embedding. It may condition on horizon-free optimization evidence such as ranks,</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.54" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.54.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.54.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.54.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.54.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p54" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p54.1" class="ltx_p">population statistics, evolution paths, distribution scale/shape, improvement, success, and</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.55" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.55.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.55.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p55" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p55.1" class="ltx_p">stagnation. A generation counter may exist only for lifecycle bookkeeping and metrics.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.56" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.56.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.56.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.57" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.57.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.57.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p57" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p57.1" class="ltx_p">## Fixed BBOB meta-evolution</span>

<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.58" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.58.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.58.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.59" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.59.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.59.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.59.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.59.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.60" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.60.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.60.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.60.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.60.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.61" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.61.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.61.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.61.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.61.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.62" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.62.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.62.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.64" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.64.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.64.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.65" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.65.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.65.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.65.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.65.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.66" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.66.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.66.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.66.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.66.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.67" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.67.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.67.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p67" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p67.1" class="ltx_p">  `[0, 0.1]`.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.68" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.68.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.68.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p68" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p68.1" class="ltx_p">- Inner diagnostic curve: clean objective regret to the known optimum, transformed with</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.69" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.69.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.69.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p69" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p69.1" class="ltx_p">  `log10(max(regret, 1e-8))`.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.70" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.70.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.70.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.70.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.70.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p70" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p70.1" class="ltx_p">- Task loss: best observed objective over all 50 generations and 16 members. Each task is</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.71" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.71.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.71.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.71.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.71.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p71" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.p71.1" class="ltx_p">  standardized across the outer population, then candidate loss is the median across tasks.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.72" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.72.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS3.p1.pic1.2.72.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">

</span></span></span></foreignObject></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 17.72 14.89)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:46.35em;--ltx-fo-height:30.61em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.22em;font-size:10pt;" height="426.65" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 423.57)" width="641.35"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:46.35em;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.1.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">## Goal</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.2" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.2.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.2.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p2.1" class="ltx_p">- Extend the binary classification Error Diffusion program to a multi-class classification problem. Achieve at least 95% `val_accuracy` on the fixed MNIST validation split, and aim for more than 98% `val_accuracy` if possible.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.3" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.3.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.3.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">- Do not use the official MNIST test split during search-time evaluation and do not write `test_accuracy` into `_results.json`.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.4.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p4.1" class="ltx_p">- Tip: Check gradient norm / activation norm at each epoch during training.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.5" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.5.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.6" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.6.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p6.1" class="ltx_p">## Rubrics</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.7" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.7.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.8" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.8.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p8" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p8.1" class="ltx_p">- Do not use backprop or autograd for the backward pass.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.9" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.9.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.9.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.9.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p9.1" class="ltx_p">- Do not use W.T (forward weights transposed) in the backward pass, because this is a sign of backprop.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.10" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.10.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.10.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.10.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p10.1" class="ltx_p">- Make sure to use the MNIST data loader provided in `example_mnist_mlp.py`, using its fixed `55k train / 5k val / 10k test` split with `split_seed=0` and `500` validation examples per class.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.11" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.11.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.11.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.11.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.11.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p11" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p11.1" class="ltx_p">- The training script must write `_results.json` with at least `val_accuracy`, `training_time`, `terminated_early`, `dataset_name`, `split_seed`, `train_examples`, `val_examples`, and `val_examples_per_class`.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.12" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.12.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.12.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.12.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.12.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p12" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p12.1" class="ltx_p">- `dataset_name` must be exactly `"MNIST"`. Synthetic or toy datasets must not pass evaluation as MNIST.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.13" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.13.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.13.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.13.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.13.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p13" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p13.1" class="ltx_p">- Downloaded datasets and caches must not be stored inside any `program_*` directory. Use a shared cache path such as `AGENTIC_DATA_DIR` when available instead of `./data` relative to the program workspace.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.14" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.14.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.14.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.14.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.14.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p14" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p14.1" class="ltx_p">- Keep the core weight updating mechanism as delta w \propto -(learning rate) x (presynaptic activity) x (postsynaptic activation derivative) x (one global error sign)</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.15" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.15.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.15.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.15.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.15.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p15" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p15.1" class="ltx_p">- Polarity invariance must be preserved through multiple layers. For this, the following must hold:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.16" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.16.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.16.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.16.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.16.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p16" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p16.1" class="ltx_p">  - all trainable weight tensors should remain non-negative (this constraint may be relaxed if needed for performance). Any violations of the non-negative constraint should be logged (e.g., the number of violated weights).</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.17" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.17.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.17.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p17" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p17.1" class="ltx_p">  - the derivative of the activation function must be non-negative.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.18" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.18.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.18.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p18" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p18.1" class="ltx_p">  - the forward pass must preserve the excitatory/inhibitory sign structure such as:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.19" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.19.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.19.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p19" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p19.1" class="ltx_p">    - `p_i = f(+p_{i-1} @ W_pp - n_{i-1} @ W_np + b_p)`</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.20" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.20.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.20.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p20" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p20.1" class="ltx_p">    - `n_i = f(+n_{i-1} @ W_nn - p_{i-1} @ W_pn + b_n)`</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.21" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.21.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.21.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.21.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.21.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p21" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p21.1" class="ltx_p">- Do not use fixed random matrices or trainable backward weights to route output errors to hidden layers, because that would make the method equivalent to Direct Feedback Alignment / Feedback Alignment.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.22" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.22.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.22.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p22" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p22.1" class="ltx_p">- Do not use any data augmentation.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.23" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.23.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.23.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p23" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p23.1" class="ltx_p">- Do not rely on random feature extractors.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.24" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.24.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.24.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p24" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p24.1" class="ltx_p">- Do not treat multi-class classification as a simple ensemble of binary ED models.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.25" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.25.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.25.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p25" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p25.1" class="ltx_p">- Focus on fully connected layer variants; do not explore conv nets or attention.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.26" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.26.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.2.26.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p26" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p1.pic1.p26.1" class="ltx_p">- Achieve at least 95% validation accuracy on the fixed MNIST validation split.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</div>
