<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Initial Task Instructions for Error-Diffusion Convolution Topic Direction</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 17.72 14.89)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:46.35em;--ltx-fo-height:30.61em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.22em;font-size:10pt;" height="426.65" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 423.57)" width="641.35"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:46.35em;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.1.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"># Goal</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.2" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.2.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.2.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p2.1" class="ltx_p">- Extend the best multi-class Error Diffusion program from `ed_mnist` (provided as `program_0/src/program.py`) to a convolutional neural network. Achieve at least 60% `val_accuracy` (equivalent to `combined_score`) on the fixed CIFAR-10 validation split, and aim for more than 85% `val_accuracy` if possible.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.3" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.3.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.3.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">- Do not use the official CIFAR-10 test split and do not write `test_accuracy` into `_results.json`.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.4.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p4.1" class="ltx_p">- Tip: Check gradient norm / activation norm at each epoch during training.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.5" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.5.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.6" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.6.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p6.1" class="ltx_p"># Rubrics</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.7" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.7.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p7.1" class="ltx_p">- Do not use backprop or autograd for the backward pass.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.8" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.8.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p8" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p8.1" class="ltx_p">- Do not use W.T (forward weights transposed) in the backward pass, because</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.9" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.9.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p9.1" class="ltx_p">  this is a sign of backprop.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.10" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.10.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.10.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.10.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p10.1" class="ltx_p">- Make sure to use the same network structure as in `example_cifar10_convnet.py`, but implement it using Error Diffusion’s dual-stream architecture. The model must use convolutional layers. Do not collapse the task back into a flat MLP on handcrafted features.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.11" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.11.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.11.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.11.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.11.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p11" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p11.1" class="ltx_p">- Make sure to use the CIFAR data loader provided in `example_cifar10_convnet.py`, using its fixed `45k train / 5k val / 10k test` split with `split_seed=0` and `500` validation examples per class.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.12" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.12.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.12.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.12.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.12.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p12" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p12.1" class="ltx_p">- The training script must write `_results.json` with at least `val_accuracy`, `training_time`, `terminated_early`, `dataset_name`, `num_conv_layers`, `split_seed`, `train_examples`, `val_examples`, and `val_examples_per_class`.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.13" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.13.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.13.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.13.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.13.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p13" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p13.1" class="ltx_p">- Print per-epoch training progress including the epoch number and validation accuracy in a parseable format such as `epoch 012 ... val_acc=0.2345` or `epoch 012 ... val=0.2345`. The evaluator may stop runs that are learning too slowly based on these logs.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.14" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.14.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.14.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p14" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p14.1" class="ltx_p">- Optimize against validation accuracy.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.15" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.15.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.15.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p15" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p15.1" class="ltx_p">- `dataset_name` must be exactly `"CIFAR10"`.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.16" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.16.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.16.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.16.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.16.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p16" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p16.1" class="ltx_p">- Downloaded datasets and caches must not be stored inside any `program_*` directory. Use a shared cache path such as `AGENTIC_DATA_DIR` when available instead of `./data` relative to the program workspace.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.17" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.17.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.17.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p17" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p17.1" class="ltx_p">- Polarity invariance must be preserved through multiple layers. For this, the</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.18" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.18.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.18.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p18" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p18.1" class="ltx_p">  following must hold:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.19" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.19.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.19.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.19.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.19.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p19" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p19.1" class="ltx_p">  - all trainable weight tensors should remain non-negative (this can be relaxed if needed to achieve the desired performance).</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.20" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.20.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.20.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p20" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p20.1" class="ltx_p">  - the derivative of the activation function must be non-negative.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.21" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.21.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.21.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p21" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p21.1" class="ltx_p">  - the forward pass must preserve the excitatory/inhibitory sign structure,</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.22" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.22.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.22.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p22" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p22.1" class="ltx_p">    including convolutional layers, for example:</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.23" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.23.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.23.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p23" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p23.1" class="ltx_p">    - `p_i = f(conv_op(p_{i-1}, W_pp) - conv_op(n_{i-1}, W_np) + b_p)`</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.24" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.24.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.24.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p24" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p24.1" class="ltx_p">    - `n_i = f(conv_op(n_{i-1}, W_nn) - conv_op(p_{i-1}, W_pn) + b_n)`</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.25" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.25.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.25.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.25.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.25.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p25" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p25.1" class="ltx_p">- Do not use fixed random matrices or trainable backward weights to route output errors to hidden layers, because that would make the method equivalent to Direct Feedback Alignment / Feedback Alignment.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.26" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.26.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.2.26.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p26" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS4.p2.pic1.p26.1" class="ltx_p">- Achieve at least 60% validation accuracy on the fixed CIFAR10 validation split.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</div>
<div class="ltx_pagination ltx_role_newpage"></div>

<div id="A7.SS5.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1" class="ltx_picture" height="276.1" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 676.77 276.1" width="676.77"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,276.1) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#0000BF;" fill="#0000BF" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 0 L 0 276.1 L 676.77 276.1 L 676.77 0 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#F2F2FF;" fill="#F2F2FF" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 3.94 0 L 3.94 251.01 L 676.77 251.01 L 676.77 0 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#E6E6E6;" fill="#E6E6E6" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 3.94 251.01 L 3.94 276.1 L 676.77 276.1 L 676.77 251.01 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 17.72 259.61)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:40.31em;--ltx-fo-height:0.69em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.19em;font-size:10pt;" height="12.3" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 9.61)" width="557.78"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:40.31em;">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Initial Task Instructions for RL-based LLM fine-tuning Topic Direction</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 17.72 14.89)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:46.35em;--ltx-fo-height:16.21em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.22em;font-size:10pt;" height="227.39" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 224.32)" width="641.35"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:46.35em;">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.1.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"># Goal</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.2" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.2.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.2.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p2.1" class="ltx_p">- Improve Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for training a language model on math reasoning tasks.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.3" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.3.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">- The base model is Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, trained on the MATH dataset using GRPO.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.4.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p4.1" class="ltx_p">- Your goal is to maximize the final validation accuracy (mean reward) of the model.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.5" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.5.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.5.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p5.1" class="ltx_p">- Evaluate candidate programs via `evaluate.py` and maximize `combined_score` from `metrics.json`.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.6" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.6.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p6.1" class="ltx_p">- Respect correctness: `correct.json` must report `correct: true`.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.7" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.7.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.7.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.7.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p7.1" class="ltx_p">- Focus on implementing ONE specific variant of your idea with ONE fixed set of hyperparameters. Do NOT perform hyperparameter tuning, grid searches, ablation studies, multiple variants, comparative experiments, or additional baseline comparisons.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.8" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.8.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.8.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.8.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p8" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p8.1" class="ltx_p">- IMPORTANT: Each evaluation runs a full GRPO training loop (20 epochs) and takes approximately 1–2 hours. When calling `evaluate.py`, you MUST set a bash timeout of at least 7200000 ms (2 hours) to avoid the process being killed prematurely.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.9" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.9.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;"></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.10" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.10.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p10.1" class="ltx_p"># Rubrics</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.11" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.11.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.11.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p11" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p11.1" class="ltx_p">- `accuracy_target`: final validation accuracy should improve over the baseline.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.12" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.12.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.12.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.12.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.12.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p12" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p12.1" class="ltx_p">- `training_stability`: training should complete without NaN losses, OOM errors, or crashes.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.13" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.13.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.13.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.13.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.13.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p13" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p13.1" class="ltx_p">- `code_safety`: program must remain executable with the provided evaluator and `grpo_utils` library.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.14" class="ltx_p" style="width:463.5pt;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.14.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:463.5pt;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.14.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.14.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.2.14.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:463.5pt;">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p14" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A7.SS5.p1.pic1.p14.1" class="ltx_p">- `evidence`: every evaluated candidate must produce `metrics.json`, `correct.json`, and rubric evidence.</span>
</span></span></span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
